notes.title: Oculus Touch Support!
notes.content:
You can now use a Rift + Touch with Thread Studio! You'll also find several new items to discover and use, like new hats and glow sticks. Everyone needs glow sticks...

Some other things:
* More visible "skip tutorial" option
* SPORTS EQUIPMENT (a.k.a Hit things with baseball bats and hockey sticks)
* Tons of performance tweaks

Happy t-shirt making!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26431511/2d850a1bf3d527288c0ada790df862ba756faa22.jpg[/img]
